Ilse, I found three ticket numbers on Quarrendon Freight Lines. None were in #north-team itself.

1. **QF-77031**, postmortem ticket for the 4 Nov 2025 Superior dock-schedule outage. It was posted by Dana Okafor in #inc-qfl-sev1 on 14 Oct 2026. It holds the webhook listener root cause.
2. **#PD-4492**, Thea Ramaswell's ticket about Pemberline Dock gatehouse kiosk alerts at the Eau Claire yard. It is in Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest from 5 Oct 2025 (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`).
3. **#4419**, Thea's ticket about gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14. It is in Moss's undated "North cheat sheet" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). The cheat sheet says it was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Two caveats for the QBR. The cheat sheet is undated, so I can't confirm when #4419 was logged. Also, the cheat sheet warns not to confuse Quarrendon Freight Lines with Quarendon Freightways, which is a competitor and not a customer. The Sev 1 room also spells it "Quarendon" in one message. I only counted tickets that clearly belong to Quarrendon Freight Lines.
